name: @nick/is-docs
description: API documentation for the @nick/is library. Frontend powered by VitePress, documentation generated with deno doc and @nick/dg, a soon-to-be-released utility for generating highly configurable markdown docs and README files from deno doc's structured output.

scripts.prepare: deno task -A docs:fmt && deno task -A clean && deno task -A docs:build
scripts.deploy: deno task -A prepare && deno run -Aq npm:gh-pages -d .vitepress/dist -e . --nojekyll -f -t -o origin -b gh-pages -r "https://github.com/nberlette/is.git" -m "chore: deploy docs to gh-pages [skip ci]" -u "Nicholas Berlette <11234104+nberlette@users.noreply.github.com>"
